newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Vote and receive a condom in Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Vote and receive a condom in Honduras.

text.p: Cast a vote, receive a condom.
That's the idea behind a plan in Honduras to promote participation in internal party elections on Dec. 1 and stem the tide of AIDS, authorities said on Wednesday.
The Health Ministry, the Liberal Party and the National Party have agreed to cooperate in the plan. The two major parties agreed to hold internal elections to select candidates on the same day.

"In addition to voting, I wish we were getting rid of the idea it's OK to be promiscuous," Guillermo Casco, secretary of the National Elections Tribunal, told reporters. "I hope we can make the citizenry more sensitive to this virus that is decimating the population."
Casco said 2.4 million to three million condoms would be sent out along with voting material in preparation for the primary-style elections.
Honduras long has had the worst AIDS problem in Central America, accounting for 60 percent of all cases in the region.
The parties will chose their candidates for president, vice president, congress, local offices and the Central American parliament in November 1997 elections.
